component.name: Draftling
component.summary: Distraction-free Markdown and Fountain editor with Git sync

description.p: Draftling is the editor of the Draftling writing devices as a program for Linux: a full-screen, keyboard-driven editor for Markdown, Fountain screenplays and plain text, organised in projects, with a built-in Git client that synchronises each project with a repository on any Git hosting service.
